description: Kafka ACL rule used to control permissions for specified SASL users to access Topic or Group resources from specified IPs.

AccessPolicy.description: Access policy for the rule. Read grants read permission; Write grants write permission. Only one value is allowed—if multiple are provided, only the first takes effect.

InstanceId.description: Instance ID for the ACL to be created.

Ip.description: IP address or subnet allowed by the rule. Supports specifying '*', which allows access from any IP. Separate multiple IPs with ','.

PatternType.description: Rule matching method. Literal: exact match; Prefixed: prefix match.

Resource.description: Name or prefix of the Topic or Group resource bound to the rule.

ResourceType.description: Resource type bound to the rule. Supports configuring 'Topic' or 'Group'.

UserName.description: SASL users allowed by the rule. Supports specifying '*', which allows access for any user.
